title: Skill
description: A reusable capability that an Actor can invoke.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (or equivalent) for the Skill's inputs.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (or equivalent) for the Skill's outputs.

binding.description: How to invoke it, for example an MCP tool name, an API endpoint, or a UI automation.

side_effects.description: Whether invoking the Skill changes external state, and whether that can be undone.

latency.description: Typical or maximum latency, for example "< 1s".

requires_assurance.description: The highest Assurance Level at which this work may be done. The effective level is the lowest of the Intent's, the Task's, the Skill's, and the performing Agent's autonomy_level.

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Extension property, namespaced with a prefix.

ref.description: Identifier of an entity: an IRI, a compact IRI such as aow:AL2, or an id relative to the document base.
